mutations.because: a path is claimed only after the write returned, so a write that fails after the exclusive open leaves its file out of `created`: the wrapper frees `[]`, the call rethrows ENOSPC, and the partial file stays on disk (the PT-9j0 accepted residual again)
command: copyAssets frees a file whose write failed after the exclusive open
